steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, set the delivery date to today while keeping the bidding end date tomorrow, publish the event, and stop when the application visibly shows whether it refused or warned about the delivery date being earlier than the bidding end.
